sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Try UP and DOWN moves
print("Trying UP...")
result = action(['UP'])
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bar = ascii_lines[0]
print(f"Bar after UP: {bar}")
print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

print("\nTrying DOWN...")
result = action(['DOWN'])
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bar = ascii_lines[0]
print(f"Bar after DOWN: {bar}")
print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

# Try clicking black border
seg = current_frame.segmentation
B_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'B']
print(f"\nBlack nodes: {len(B_nodes)}")
for n in B_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"  Black node at ({cr}, {cc}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Try clicking black border
if B_nodes:
    n = B_nodes[0]
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"\nClicking black border at ({cr}, {cc})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    colors = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        c = n['color']
        colors[c] = colors.get(c, 0) + 1
    print(f"Colors after: {colors}")
    
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    bar = ascii_lines[0]
    print(f"Bar after: {bar}")
    print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
